description: This Java source file defines the CustomerDashboardController class, which manages the customer dashboard (profile) page functionality within a Spring MVC web application. It handles routing for displaying the dashboard, fetches customer options, populates the model for rendering the view, and enforces security roles.

classes.name: CustomerDashboardController
classes.description: Controller handling the customer dashboard view, inheriting from AbstractController, with dependencies injected via Spring's @Autowired, managing customer options display and security.

methods.name: displayCustomerDashboard
methods.description: Handles GET requests to show the customer dashboard page, retrieves the customer data from session, and populates the model with customer options and UI section info; returns view name.

methods.name: getCustomerOptions
methods.description: Fetches customer options for the specified store and language, populates option objects with customer attribute data, and adds them to the model.
